profile.headline: ML/AI in Marketplaces at Uber
profile.jobTitle: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Machine Learning
profile.summary: Developing algorithms and systems to solve hard problems at web-scale on the LinkedIn social graph using techniques including graph neural networks, multi-objective optimization, locality sensitive hashing, and linear and non-linear optimization, along with other machine learning and AI technologies.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Machine Learning
Insight Data Science Fellow
positions.description:
-Built FranklinFinder, an app that analyzes an uploaded photo to find similar looking dogs to rescue.
-Developed a feature set using a convolutional neural network to describe the similarity of dogs.
-Deployed FranklinFinder using flask, nginx, gunicorn, and linode.

positions.title: Postdoctoral Associate
positions.description:
– Developed a C++ framework to quickly design and implement new strategies for searching for beyond-the-standard-model physics in the CMS experiment at the Large Hadron Collider.
– Introduced MVA techniques to discriminate between real and fake reconstructed particle tracks.
– Led the transition of the strip tracker to the new timing and trigger distribution system.
– Ran analysis and simulation calculations on thousands of nodes across the scientific grid.
– Wrote 12 publications that resulted in over 450 citations and co-authored 335 publications.

positions.title: Graduate Researcher
positions.description:
– Advanced the understanding of the gluon polarization in the proton by analyzing hundreds of millions of events collected by the STAR experiment.
– Performed in-situ calibration of electromagnetic calorimeter and reduced associated uncertainties.
– Developed and maintained software for collecting and reconstructing data from calorimeters.
– Carried out first large-scale simulation on cloud resources by a particle physicist.
– Wrote 3 publications and co-authored 54 publications.

honors.title: LPC Distinguished Researcher
honors.description: Recognizes CMS members who have an established track record of expertise in physics analysis, object reconstruction, and detector studies, as well as experience organizing and leading groups of physicists.

honors.title: CMS Achievement Award
honors.description: For outstanding and continuous contributions to the Strip Tracker DAQ, Tracker operation and training of newcomers, as well as being very active in the Tracking POG, working on the track selection based on MVA techniques.

publications.title: Searches for heavy Higgs bosons in two-Higgs-doublet models and for t to ch decay using multilepton and diphoton final states in pp collisions at √s=8 TeV
Searches for electroweak production of charginos, neutralinos, and sleptons decaying to leptons and W, Z, and Higgs bosons in pp collission at √s=8 TeV
